subject: Okta technical audit & identity-ops assessment — renewal planning
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Taylor Jennings <taylor.jennings@okta.com>; procurement@okta.com
Cc: marcus.lin@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Okta technical audit & identity-ops assessment — renewal planning

Hi Taylor —

We’re starting renewal planning for our Okta estate (term ends 2026-10-31) and want to align on a combined technical audit + identity-ops assessment before we commit to licensing and any device-posture add-on. High-level asks: 

- Can Okta run a 2-week technical audit focused on SSO, MFA configurations, SCIM provisioning, and device posture rules?
- We’d like a short remediation and risk report + an SOW and fixed price for the work. Please flag any prerequisites (logs, admin accounts, test tenants).
- Would Okta consolidate the audit into the renewal (one invoice / PO) or should we buy as a separate professional services engagement?

Attached is our current license count export (summary tab) to help scope. Marcus, Laura — looping you in for procurement and security impacts.

Goal: complete audit and remediation plan by 2026-09-10 so we can finalize commercial terms. Can you confirm feasibility and provide a draft SOW and rough cost by EOD Friday 2026-08-20?

Thanks,

Kimberly Park
Head of IT Procurement
Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com
[Attachment: Identity-License-Counts-202608.xlsx]

From: Taylor Jennings <taylor.jennings@okta.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@okta.com; Sara Patel <sara.patel@identitypartners.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 14:41:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Okta technical audit & identity-ops assessment — renewal planning

Hi Kimberly —

Thanks for the detail and the spreadsheet. Okta can absolutely run a combined technical audit + identity operations assessment. Quick answers: 

- Scope: Our standard "Tenant Health & Security Audit" covers SSO, MFA policies, OIDC flows, SCIM, and device posture (we’ll need admin-level read access plus a short list of representative user/endpoint types).
- Timeline: 10 business days on-site/remote work + 3 days for the final remediation report. We can start as early as 2026-08-24.
- Commercials: We offer PS work either as a separate engagement or bundled into renewal credits. For bundling we typically require a minimum one-year subscription commitment.

I’ve attached a draft SOW and a ballpark estimate (labor + optional remediation blocks). Procurement email included for PO routing.

Proposed next step: 30-minute intake call with your engineering/security leads to confirm scope and grant access. Are Marcus or Vivek available Thursday 2026-08-20 at 10:00 PT?

Best,

Taylor Jennings
Enterprise Solutions Architect, Okta
taylor.jennings@okta.com
[Attachment: Okta_Technical_Audit_SOW_v1.pdf]

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 08:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Okta technical audit & identity-ops assessment — renewal planning

Thanks Taylor —

We can do 08/20 at 10:00PT. A couple of clarifications from procurement/security side: 

1) If we bundle the audit into the renewal, we need clear deliverable-based milestones tied to billing (PO vs credit). Please include milestone language in the SOW (draft acceptance, remediation acceptance).
2) Licensing: the spreadsheet is a snapshot; expect +5-8% growth by renewal due to hiring. Can you include license uplift scenarios (steady growth vs accelerated hiring) in your quote?
3) Evidence: for SOC/compliance audits we need an exportable evidence pack (logs, config snapshots). Can Okta provide these artifacts as part of the deliverable?

Laura — please confirm you can attend the intake call and that security will provide the access list. Vivek — looping you for technical review after the intake.

Marcus Lin
Sr. Manager, Vendor Ops
Redwood Inference

Hi Kimberly/Marcus —

IdentityPartners can act as an independent third-party to run the assessment (we often complement vendor-led audits when customers want an unbiased remediation roadmap). A few notes: 

- We’ll need a read-only admin account and a scoped set of logs for the 30-day baseline.
- Pricing model: fixed-fee for assessment + time-and-materials for remediation support. We estimate $18k-$28k depending on tenant complexity.
- Deliverables: executive summary, technical findings, prioritized remediation backlog, and a compliance evidence bundle (suitable for internal auditors).

If you want, we can join the intake call on 08/20 and provide an independent intake checklist.

Regards,

Sara Patel
Principal Consultant
IdentityPartners LLC
sara.patel@identitypartners.com

Team —

Thanks all for the quick responses and the SOW. Summary / decisions from our side after internal sync: 

- We will run the vendor-led Okta audit (Taylor) and concurrently engage IdentityPartners for an independent assessment. Both deliverables must include an evidence bundle for SOC/Procurement.
- Procurement preference is to purchase the Okta audit as a one-off PS engagement (separate invoice/PO) to avoid complicating renewal credits. Taylor — please update the SOW with PO-friendly invoice milestones and include the evidence artifact list.
- Vivek: please create the access list and share credentials method (prefer Okta org connect + temporary admin account) by EOD 2026-08-26.
- Target to have both reports by 2026-09-09 so we can finalize licensing options ahead of renewal.

Next step: 08/20 intake call at 10:00PT (calendar invite to follow).

Kimberly Park
Head of IT Procurement
